scope: parallel serena-light registration; not canonical-serena replacement

coordinates.text_offset: decoded-text offset in the exact verified snapshot
coordinates.byte_offset: physical UTF-8 file offset in the same snapshot, including any BOM

semantic_contract.navigation_success_coordinates: compact [[start_line,start_column],[end_line,end_column]] ranges retain the same 0-based decoded-text line and Unicode code-point column semantics; text and byte offsets remain internal
semantic_contract.assignment_bodies: Python module-executed variables/constants and TypeScript/JavaScript top-level variable bindings return a unique complete assignment statement when include_body=true; TypeScript/JavaScript includes an existing terminal semicolon and requires the exact selected snapshot text to equal the semantic candidate name; body lookup and guarded editing share the same fail-closed recovery
semantic_contract.semantic_replay: at most 64 unique workspace plus external target URIs; exact runtime token, complete capability identity, encoding, generations, and canonical location multiset must remain stable; deterministic overflow is non-retryable UNSUPPORTED
semantic_contract.diagnostics_publication: versioned engines install ownership before didChange and require integer publication version evidence; unversioned engines disown old tracking, send didClose, await a bounded same-connection response barrier, and only then install a new owner before exact-full-text didOpen or cached diagnostics reuse; watcher-created temporary opens never close a URI already owned open, and close publications plus barrier or notification failures cannot satisfy or leave the new generation
semantic_contract.external_identity: a trusted external file's identity is its own authoritative absolute path plus an optional read_only=true marker on its compact file group; no second non-forgeable external identifier or alternate trust owner is introduced
semantic_contract.raw_position_fallback: a reference, declaration, or implementation record backed by an exact response-owned snapshot uses compact range; only an authorized read-only external target lacking that snapshot may carry raw_range plus a position_basis naming the raw LSP coordinate system; a workspace target that cannot be mapped exactly fails retryably with typed NOT_READY rather than degrading to raw coordinates

common_old_to_new.data.sha256 and repeated record hashes: data.files[*].sha256 once, only when a returned record includes body
common_old_to_new.numeric kind: stable lowercase kind string; unknown values become unknown:<integer>
common_old_to_new.workspace/adapter/generations/configured: removed from navigation success; detailed runtime state remains in get_runtime_status and rich errors
common_old_to_new.FastMCP pretty text: one canonical UTF-8 JSON text block equal to structuredContent

optional_field_contract.file_group.language: present only for mixed-language results or when path identity does not reveal the language
optional_field_contract.file_group.read_only: true only for authoritative read-only external paths
optional_field_contract.file_group.sha256: present once only when at least one record in the group contains body
optional_field_contract.overview.children: present only when non-empty; a nonmatching structural ancestor is removed and counted if final budgeting removes its last matching descendant
optional_field_contract.symbol.body_or_info: body or info appears only when requested and available
optional_field_contract.reference.symbol: containing name path or typed <file> container when available
optional_field_contract.reference.snippet: omitted by default; a positive max_snippet_chars requests a complete bounded snippet
optional_field_contract.data.coverage: present once for reference success only, including empty reference success
optional_field_contract.target.name_path_kind_body_info: response-owned workspace targets expose bounded semantic name_path, kind, body, or info only when available or requested; positive kind filters remove and count unknown targets, while exclusions preserve unknown targets
optional_field_contract.target.raw_range_position_basis: mutually exclusive with decoded range; only for a read-only external target without an exact response-owned snapshot

get_symbols_overview.old: data.relative_path/sha256/max_depth/depth flags plus verbose nodes with name_path, ranges, selection ranges, detail, and child booleans
get_symbols_overview.parameters: max_answer_chars 512..50000 default 12000; include_kinds/exclude_kinds use stable lowercase kind names; filtering retains only the minimum ancestor path for matching descendants and counts every removed node in omitted

find_symbol.old: single-symbol or global adapters/symbols envelopes with repeated path, adapter, generations, configured-program and rich range offsets
find_symbol.parameters: max_matches 1..100 default 20 after filter/dedup/sort; max_answer_chars 512..50000 default 12000

find_referencing_symbols.old: flat references repeat path/read-only and carry rich ranges, snippet flags, adapter/generations, truncation and coverage inside verbose success
find_referencing_symbols.parameters: max_snippet_chars default 0 omits snippets; positive values request them; max_answer_chars 512..50000 default 12000

find_declaration.old: data.locations contains absolute/relative path, capability matrix, location kind and rich or raw LSP ranges
find_declaration.parameters: regex requires exactly one capture group; max_answer_chars 512..50000 default 12000

find_implementations.old: data.locations repeats request path/name, capability matrix, adapter/generations and rich target ranges
find_implementations.parameters: max_answer_chars 512..50000 default 12000; integer include_kinds/exclude_kinds filter verified response-owned target kinds within the replay transaction, and include_info adds bounded semantic detail without raw LSP blobs

mcp_tools.name: activate_workspace
mcp_tools.delta: absolute path and session-scoped binding replace project name/path and global active project

mcp_tools.name: release_workspace
mcp_tools.delta: detaches the binding while retaining the lease; immediate=true skips grace only for the final holder; runtime_stopped and runtime_stop_pending distinguish settled from retained cleanup

mcp_tools.name: get_runtime_status
mcp_tools.delta: typed daemon, lease, capability, scope, and generation status replaces agent configuration

mcp_tools.name: get_symbols_overview
mcp_tools.delta: compact name/kind/non-empty-children tree; lowercase kind filters; no ranges or runtime metadata

mcp_tools.name: find_symbol
mcp_tools.delta: file-grouped compact symbols with default max_matches=20; body requests retain complete recovered statements and one file hash

mcp_tools.name: find_referencing_symbols
mcp_tools.delta: file-grouped compact semantic references plus one query-level configured-program coverage object; snippets are omitted by default and included only when max_snippet_chars is above zero; no lexical fallback

mcp_tools.name: find_declaration
mcp_tools.delta: definitionProvider dispatch and compact grouped targets; regex schema requires exactly one capture group

mcp_tools.name: get_diagnostics_for_file
mcp_tools.delta: generation-aware status replaces line-range interface; returned ranges use 0-based decoded-text positions

mcp_tools.name: get_diagnostics_for_symbol
mcp_tools.delta: path plus symbol required; no reference-file expansion; returned ranges use 0-based decoded-text positions

mcp_tools.name: replace_symbol_body
mcp_tools.delta: whole-file expected_hash is mandatory; Python and TypeScript/JavaScript assignment edits use the same complete fail-closed recovery as body lookup; parent-rename races are fail-closed or UNCERTAIN after installation; never replay after unknown completion

serena.reason: serena-light binds inherited connector cwd without a hook

serena-light.behavior: auto-activate startup cwd; explicit activate_workspace for another root

instruction_consumers.name: initial_instructions
instruction_consumers.reason: no Serena agent manual or mode system

instruction_consumers.name: client MCP tool metadata
instruction_consumers.reason: tool schemas and typed envelopes are the client-facing contract

excluded_serena_tools.family: memory, onboarding, configuration, and project management

known_limitations.rich_error_text_budget: candidate-bearing semantic error evidence is bounded using the caller's public answer budget, but rich error envelopes remain on FastMCP's ordinary renderer and their client-visible pretty text is not itself hard-capped by max_answer_chars; compact success is hard-capped
known_limitations.declaration_ambiguity_candidates: declaration and implementation source-symbol ambiguity candidates are bounded by the symbols in one authorized file but do not yet receive the caller's public answer budget
known_limitations.external_include_info: when a read-only external target lacks a response-owned snapshot, requesting body or info fails closed with a typed unsupported result rather than returning unverified detail
